mapper.select: select mn.Bdd_Id, mn.Bdd_Number, mn.Bdd_Parent_Id, mn.Bdd_Name, mn.Bdd_Code, mn.Bdd_Price, mn.Bdd_Total, (select sum(con.Con_Money_Total) from Con_Contract con where con.Con_Budget_Id=mn.Bdd_Id and con.Con_Approval_State=7) as conMoneyTotal, (select sum(py.Pay_Apply) from Con_Pay py left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=py.Con_Id where con.Con_Budget_Id=mn.Bdd_Id and py.Pay_State=7) as conPayTotal from Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl mn left join Inv_Budget_Declare bd on mn.Bd_Id=bd.Bd_Id where bd.Bd_State=7 and bd.P_Id=#{pId} order by mn.Bdd_Order ASC

select * from Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl
1=1
and Bd_Id in
#{item}
order by bdd_order ASC

select mn.*, con.Con_Id as conId, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal from Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl mn left join Inv_Budget_Declare bd on bd.Bd_Id = mn.Bd_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Budget_Id = mn.Bdd_Id where bd.Bd_State = 7 and bd.P_Id = #{pId}
